messages:
lina: Heads-up — proposing a new `constrained-rollout` runtime flag to limit routing changes during peak. Want a quick sync on API shape + console preview before I open the RFC PR.
ben: Curious — why not reuse existing targeted-scope/quota primitives? What's the new capability here?
maria: Short + pragmatic please, I need the mockups for Console preview.
lina: Good q. This is specifically about limiting the *rate* of routing activations (e.g., only 10% of routes can flip per 5m window) and allowing safe exclusions (top routes, SLOs). The goal: make rollouts less likely to cause cascading capacity shifts.
sam: Sketch the schema — will help us spot eval issues.
lina: Example sketch:
```json
{
  "name": "constrained-rollout",
  "rate_limit": {"percent": 10, "window": "5m"},
  "exclusions": ["top_5_routes", "slo:latency>200ms"],
  "mode": "dry-run|enforce"
}
```
sam: Minor preference: use `window_secs` integer rather than a human string. Easier for the engine.
ben: We also need audit metadata: `applied_by`, `applied_at`, `reverted_by`, and TTL/auto-revert semantics for safety.
devex: Console needs a preview pane that shows: sample affected routes (approx count), telemetry delta estimate, and a `what-if` toggle for dry-run. Also show determinism seed so previews are reproducible.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary check triggered — baseline latency +1.2% in us-west-1 at 12:21 — constraint-rollout dry-run 2387654321 (no enforcement).
maria: Interaction with fallback policies is important. If the constraint blocks a critical emergency fallback we must allow an override path (audited). Suggest an `emergency_override` field scoped to roles.
aaron: API suggestion: POST /runtime/constraints with body {dry_run:true, preview:true} returning {sample_routes:[...], telemetry_estimate:{tokens_per_sec:-10}, seed:12345}. Keep it synchronous for preview but async for enforcement.
lina: Ok — will switch to `window_secs`, add audit fields and `emergency_override` + enum mode. I'll open RFC + PR with console mocks. @ben can you draft TTL/revert rules? @maria can you mock the preview UI with sample data?
ben: :thumbsup: I'll take TTL & revert semantics. Quick Q: should sampling be deterministic per-customer (seeded) so preview -> enforce is reproducible?
maria: Yes — deterministic sampling helps comparing dry-run to enforce. Include `seed` and `seed_hint` in the preview API.
devex: Also surface a link to the runbook directly in the preview pane: `/docs/runbooks/constraint-rollouts` and a short checklist (smoke, telemetry query, revert steps).
lina: Great — target: RFC + PR by EOD Friday. If anyone has blocking concerns drop them here or DM. Thanks!
